svg.aria-label: Lumen reflections: hit / miss and hit distance
svg.title: Lumen reflections: hit / miss and hit distance
svg.desc: Captured buffer visualization. Lumen reflections: hit / miss and hit distance graph 0001 | TraceVoxels pass | signed float16 ray distance hit distance (log10, near=blue -> far=red) miss (positive distance, no surface hit) unused trace tile EncodeRayDistance stores negative distance for a hit and positive distance for a miss. The figure keeps that sign: blue = miss, heat = hit, navy = cleared/unused. Hit distance is in Unreal units (cm), the ray's t value. The first decoding pass used raw distance; the manifest records hit/miss counts and min/max. A miss is still a traced ray (sky/radiance-cache); it is not an invalid tile.
